thread.title: Apple moves closer to smart speaker launch, FCC filing suggests - MarketWatch

author: Max A. Cherney
title: Apple moves closer to smart speaker launch, FCC filing suggests - MarketWatch
text:
Published: Jan 19, 2018 5:29 p.m. ET Share Max A. Cherney Tech reporter 
Apple Inc. AAPL, -0.45% has filed new documents with the Federal Communications Commission that suggest its HomePod speaker launch may be approaching. Made public Friday, the documents include a diagram of the bottom of a "wireless speaker" that includes the location of an FCC label required on such devices and a series of reports about the radio emissions dated Nov. 8, 2017. Apple stock is up a fraction to $178.56 in late trading. Already a late entrant, behind tech titans such as Amazon.com Inc. AMZN, +0.10% and Alphabet Inc. GOOGL, +0.66% [s:goog], Apple delayed its smart speaker launch in November , and said it would ship in early 2018. Apple stock is up 49% in the last 12 months, as the S&P 500 index SPX, +0.44% has gained 24%. The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +0.21% of which Apple is a component, gained 32% in the past 12 months. Quote References
